name: Apart Chamins
beschreibung: The Apart Chamins is a holiday home in Tyrol, Austria. Situated in a peaceful location, the property serves as a convenient base for exploring the surrounding area. The holiday apartments feature a separately appointed kitchen and a living area. A garden and parking spaces are at guests' disposal. A lockable storage room for skis and bicycles is also available. Wi-Fi access is provided in public areas. The region offers ample opportunities for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. The property is well suited for guests seeking an independent holiday.
